title: Class of 2006: the group chat
instr: Twenty years after school, four old classmates are chatting in their WhatsApp group. Say each missing bit, then tap to check.

steps.intro: WhatsApp group "Class of 2006 🎓" · Jess, Ollie, Nadia, Chris

p: Mum's clearing out the attic, and she's found my old school reports! 📦 Perfect timing for the reunion 😂
Ollie, listen to this: "Jessica would do better in French if she didn't sit next to Oliver, who talks far too much." Signed Mrs Martin 😂
😂 Nothing's changed, then.
Excuse me. These days I talk far too much in French. IN FRANCE.
Wait, you live in France?? Last I heard, you were in Leeds.
Yep, Lyon. Six years now. My wife's French. And yes, I know — I spent five years telling everyone French was

Mine's here too. Look: "Christopher put a lot of work into his science project."

😂 Right, back to the reunion. Drinks at the Red Lion on 12 December? Who's in?
In!

Oh, Ollie. That's lovely. I'll ask my niece's school to pass on a message.
